text:
alex (SRE): Proposal: create a tiny "handoff handshake" and a fixed follow-up schedule for postmortem action items. We've had too many stale 30/90-day tasks.

rachel (PM): Love this. What does the handshake look like? who signs off?

alex (SRE): Minimal: outgoing IC documents current state + outstanding remediation list; incoming IC confirms receipt and 24h shadow; owner field set on each remediation with backup. Could be 4 lines in the postmortem header.

kevin (Eng): Agree. Also: make owner + spec (what success looks like) mandatory on the PM block. If missing, bot should add a blocker label and ping the channel.

mina (Ops): For cadence: Day 0 assign + open tracker, Day 2 check-in, Day 10 progress update, Day 30 verification, Day 60 validate metrics, Day 90 close or extend with justification. Keep weekly updates only while active work is happening.

sam (oncall): Can infra-bot auto-create a GH issue when the postmortem lands? It should include labels: severity, failure-mode, owner, ETA. If unassigned after 48h, bot posts in #eng-oncall.

infra-bot: Action: configured prototype "pm-meta-consumer" that can create GH issues and schedule reminders. Test run scheduled.

rachel (PM): Communication rules: initial incident note to stakeholders within 48h; short status bullets every 7 days until Day 30; consolidated product update at Day 30 and Day 90. Keep it 3 bullets max.

alex (SRE): I'd like a simple taxonomy: network, db, deploy, regression, external-api, config. We'll tag each postmortem. Monthly pattern review (30 mins) to catch repeats.

kevin (Eng): About IC rotation: 2-week IC blocks. Last two days of block: handoff checklist + overlap shadowing. Reduces handoff overhead.

mina (Ops): Minor nit: we need a forced gating check when closing a postmortem's tracking issue: must include evidence (logs, dashboards link, test). Otherwise it cannot be closed.

alex (SRE): Here's a suggestion for the postmortem metadata header (YAML):
```yaml
postmortem_id: pm-<shortid>
severity: P1/P2
pattern: deploy|network|db|regression|external-api|config
owner: displayname
backup: displayname
due_date: YYYY-MM-DD
acceptance_criteria: short bullet list or link
```

kevin (Eng): That looks good. Can we make GH issue title use the postmortem_id for easy searching? e.g., "infra/postmortem-pm-1234: brief desc"

infra-bot: Prototype will create GH issue: prefix infra/postmortem-<id>, apply labels from YAML, schedule reminders at 48h and Day 7.

rachel (PM): One more thing: assign a comms owner for stakeholder updates (could be PM or IC). We need one explicit person responsible for the 48h summary.

sam (oncall): I'll update the oncall doc to reflect 2-week rotation and the handshake steps. Will circulate a PR.

alex (SRE): Action items from thread: 1) Alex to drop YAML snippet in the template. 2) Infra to finish bot prototype and GH template. 3) Sam to update oncall rotation + checklist. 4) Rachel to write comms cadence bullets. 5) Ops to schedule monthly 30-min pattern review. Target: have PRs and prototype by end of week.

kevin (Eng): +1. If anyone wants to pair on the GH template I can help.

mina (Ops): For the pattern review, also populate a simple dashboard: count by pattern over last 90 days, average MTTR by pattern. This will help prioritize engineering work.

infra-bot: Reminder created: "PM metadata missing owner" will fire if postmortem YAML doesn't include owner within 24h.

rachel (PM): Thanks all. Short sync tomorrow to align on fields? 15-min.

alex (SRE): I'm in. I'll post the initial template in this thread after the sync.

sam (oncall): Great work  will watch the PRs.
